```yaml
name: macOS ARM PyInstaller

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-macos-arm:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
        run: |
          brew update
          brew install pyinstaller
        shell: bash

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Create and activate virtual environment
        run: |
          python -m venv .venv
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt || true
        shell: bash

      - name: Run PyInstaller script
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          bash pyinstaller.sh
        shell: bash

      - name: Archive .app bundle
        run: |
          cd dist
          zip -r ../SSHPilot.app.zip SSHPilot.app
        shell: bash

      - name: Compute DMG checksum
        run: |
          shasum -a 256 SSHPilot.dmg > SSHPilot.dmg.sha256
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload DMG artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot.dmg
          path: SSHPilot.dmg

      - name: Upload .app zip artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot.app.zip
          path: SSHPilot.app.zip

      - name: Upload checksum artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SSHPilot.dmg.sha256
          path: SSHPilot.dmg.sha256
```
